rationale: C21 plausibly supplied a concrete template for the later response to the Paley Commission. Both letters open by praising a commission report, characterize it as a broad and forceful analysis linking international economic cooperation to peace and freedom, anticipate consideration by Congress and the executive branch, and close by thanking the commission and its staff for an important public contribution. C11 supplies subject-specific language about the Materials Policy Commission, but C21 is the much closer drafting model for a post-report commendation letter.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Your Commission's report is a landmark in its field... such a broad and farsighted appraisal... Nor... has the conclusion ever been so forcefully stated and documented
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I am impressed by the report of the Advisory Board on International Development. It demonstrates, clearly and forcefully...
shared_material.explanation: Both begin with an emphatic assessment of a commission report and stress the breadth and force of its conclusions.

shared_material.child_excerpt: international cooperation in resource development and international trade in raw materials is imperative to world peace and prosperity
shared_material.parent_excerpt: International partnership is necessary to build an expanding world economy in which all can have a fair share.
shared_material.explanation: The central substantive conclusion is expressed through closely parallel language connecting international economic cooperation with worldwide peace and prosperity.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I am sure they merit careful consideration, not only by the Congress and the executive branch of the Federal Government
shared_material.parent_excerpt: your report will be of great help in enabling the Congress and the Executive Branch to develop the kind of program which is needed
shared_material.explanation: Both explicitly route the report's recommendations toward consideration by Congress and the executive branch.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I extend to your Commission and its staff my thanks and congratulations for the public service you have rendered.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Please accept my deepest personal appreciation for the task which your Board has accomplished... You, your Board, and your staff can take great pride in the contribution which you have made
shared_material.explanation: The closing commendation uses the same commission-or-board-and-staff structure and praises their public contribution.
